tools.name: get_premarket_gappers
tools.description:
Gapper Scanner (FREE preview) — 5-pillar low-float momentum gap scan
(gap >=10%, price $1-$100, float <=100M, premarket volume >=50k; relative volume ranks the board and news is flagged; independent implementation, defaults differ from any educator's published
criteria). Finds cheap small-cap stocks

tools.name: get_market_health_history
tools.description:
Market Health history: the composite risk-score snapshots for the last 30
days (hourly, with flips7d = label changes in the last 7 days), a ~30-session
derived line series per detector (percent vs moving average, ratios vs their
MAs, N-day percent changes and spreads — never raw prices), and signalC

tools.name: get_market_valuation
tools.description:
S&P 500 valuation verdict from a discounted-earnings (equity-risk-premium)
model: verdict (Very cheap / Cheap / Fair value / Rich / Very rich), the equity
risk premium the market currently implies (impliedErpPct, in percent — lower
means richer), the zone on the ladder, how far the market sits above

forward inflation and the effective fed funds rate (percent, eac

tools.name: get_cross_asset_regime
tools.description:
Cross-asset regime read, derived values only: 60-session stock-bond and
dollar-stock return correlations (-1..1), 20-session percent changes of the
gold/S&P ratio, copper/gold ratio and WTI crude, the VIX/VIX3M ratio with a
contango / backwardation word (above 1.0 = backwardation), and the MOVE/VIX

tools.name: get_market_breadth
